title: Links to repo of the v1 examples are broken
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
When going to https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v1/examples/, the links to the repo of each example are erroring with a 404:

* https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/master/docs/examples/media
* https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/master/docs/examples/e-commerce
* https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/master/docs/examples/tourism

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**
They should link to the GitHub directory holding the code (could not find it, sorry)
